summary: campitks 519134 + KDWP (Wayback Aug 2026): 50/30/20 A W/E and 4 full-hookup sites, 208 campsites (126 with utilities), pull-throughs, showers year round, open year round, site-specific reservable with self-reg, 14-night cap, 2027 holiday 3-night minimum. Note's 'water/showers Apr-Sep' is out of date (now year round). Lakefront kept for Hell Creek; Otoe RV loops are lakeview. Split candidate (Hell Creek/Otoe).
flags: WATERFRONT: LAKEFRONT kept, earned at Hell Creek. Big Bluestem's north row (096-099) and point (074-081) and Wheatgrass's outer row (039-048) sit ~15-30 m from the shoreline across open mown grass, pads on the outside of the loop road, nothing between (Esri + NAIP 2026-11-06 with campitks coordinates). Otoe's RV loops are not on the water: Yarrow 136-162 fills the middle of its peninsula ~60-90 m from the shore with the loop road between, Goldenrod 176-185 ~100 m inland - open grassland with the lake in sight, so LAKEVIEW. Otoe's shoreline sites (Sagewort, Sunflower, Coneflower) are primitive tent sites. Foxtail (full hookup) ~120 m inland, Grama (electric) back from the shore. campitks tags every one of its 184 sites 'Lakefront' including inland ones, so that tag proves nothing.

SPLIT CANDIDATE (don't split; for AWH): Hell Creek and Otoe are separate places. RV-site centroids: Hell Creek 38.92129,-98.50911 (95 utility sites), Otoe 38.92692,-98.49425 (35 utility sites), 1.43 km apart; nearest sites (Big Bluestem 097 to Sunflower 175) 600 m apart across open water. Imagery shows separate road access: Hell Creek from the south, Otoe from Shoreline Drive / KS-232 to the northeast, with no park road joining them. KDWP lists them as separate areas with separate site counts. If split, Otoe would be lakeview, W/E only (Yarrow 30/20, Goldenrod 50/30/20), 37 W/E + 43 primitive.
